meta.solver: LSODA (rtol 1e-7, atol [1e-9,1e-7,1e-5], max_step 60 s) for deterministic runs; rk4_batch for the CTMC days S13/S14
meta.h_s_note: h applies to the S13/S14 Monte Carlo only (LSODA is adaptive)
meta.key_format: {S}|Tamb={degC}|soh={SOH:.1f}|s0={s0:.2f}; S10a = S4 and S10b = S12 on an aged pack; S9 starts at T0 = 20 °C unless 'S9-T0=Tamb'; S7-nothrottle has throttling and the burst envelope disabled (as in final_proto.py)
meta.units: s_off_pct = displayed SOC D1 at shutdown; soe_off_pct = energy-fraction SOC D2; P_mean_W = delivered energy / TTE; P_demand_W = schedule-mean demand before throttling; rho_perf = time-averaged delivered SoC performance
